description: SvAutoComplete in Svelte 5 as a search field: free text with a live-filtered suggestion list where any value is accepted and suggestions are shortcuts, shown as a city search with a label and a hint and as a filter-syntax helper. Controlled through value and onChange on the shared editor contract.

faq.question: Does the value have to match a suggestion?
faq.answer: No. Whatever the user types is the value; picking a suggestion just fills it in. Use SvComboBox when the value must come from a list.

faq.question: How are suggestions filtered?
faq.answer: By substring match on the suggestions array as you type; pass a new array to control them yourself, for example from a server.

faq.question: Which keys work?
faq.answer: Down opens and moves through suggestions, Enter accepts the highlighted one, Escape closes the list and keeps the typed text.
